import asyncio, json, re, shutil
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

ROOT = Path('/home/t-demiwang/project/Code-Web-Skills/external/webwright/evals/webarena/train_32_runs/shopping/task126_scratch_20260807_211932')
FINAL_RUNS = ROOT / 'final_runs'
FINAL_RUNS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
run_nums = []
for p in FINAL_RUNS.glob('run_*'):
    try:
        run_nums.append(int(p.name.split('_')[1]))
    except Exception:
        pass
RUN_ID = max(run_nums, default=0)
RUN_DIR = FINAL_RUNS / f'run_{RUN_ID}'
SS_DIR = RUN_DIR / 'screenshots'
LOG = RUN_DIR / 'final_script_log.txt'
AGENT_RESPONSE = ROOT / 'agent_response.json'

for d in [RUN_DIR, SS_DIR]:
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
LOG.write_text('')

def log(msg):
    with LOG.open('a') as f:
        f.write(msg + '\n')
    print(msg)

EXCLUDE = [
    'case','cable','charger','album','print head','printhead','replacement','accessories','accessory',
    'cartridge','toner','paper set',' sleeve','sleeve','adapter','film','cover','parts','laser unit'
]

def include_product(name: str) -> bool:
    n = name.lower()
    if 'canon' not in n or 'printer' not in n:
        return False
    if any(b in n for b in EXCLUDE):
        return False
    return ('photo' in n) or ('pixma' in n) or ('selphy' in n)

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 1280, 'height': 1800})
        page = await context.new_page()

        step = 1
        log(f'step {step} action: open One Stop Market home page')
        await page.goto('http://ec2-18-223-172-69.us-east-2.compute.amazonaws.com:7770', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        await page.screenshot(path=str(SS_DIR / f'final_execution_{step}_open_home.png'))

        step += 1
        log(f'step {step} action: search for Canon photo printer using the site search box')
        await page.get_by_placeholder('Search entire store here...').fill('Canon photo printer')
        await page.get_by_role('button', name='Search').click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('domcontentloaded')
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        await page.screenshot(path=str(SS_DIR / f'final_execution_{step}_search_results.png'))

        products = await page.locator('li.product-item').evaluate_all("""
        els => els.map(el => {
          const name = el.querySelector('.product-item-link')?.textContent?.trim() || '';
          const price = el.querySelector('.price')?.textContent?.trim() || '';
          return {name, price};
        }).filter(x => x.name)
        """)
        parsed = []
        for item in products:
            price_text = item['price'].replace('$','').replace(',','').strip()
            if not price_text:
                continue
            try:
                price = float(price_text)
            except Exception:
                continue
            parsed.append({'name': item['name'], 'price': price, 'included': include_product(item['name'])})
        included = [x for x in parsed if x['included']]
        included_sorted = sorted(included, key=lambda x: x['price'])
        log('Visible parsed products on results page:')
        for x in parsed:
            log(json.dumps(x, ensure_ascii=False))
        if not included_sorted:
            result = {"task_type":"RETRIEVE","status":"NOT_FOUND_ERROR","retrieved_data":None,"error_details":None}
            AGENT_RESPONSE.write_text(json.dumps(result))
            log('Final response: NOT_FOUND_ERROR')
            await browser.close()
            return

        min_price = included_sorted[0]['price']
        max_price = included_sorted[-1]['price']
        log(f'step {step+1} action: compute visible Canon photo printer price range from filtered semantic product set; min={min_price}, max={max_price}')
        log('Included products for range computation:')
        for x in included_sorted:
            log(json.dumps(x, ensure_ascii=False))
        await page.screenshot(path=str(SS_DIR / f'final_execution_{step+1}_range_evidence.png'))

        payload = {
            "task_type": "RETRIEVE",
            "status": "SUCCESS",
            "retrieved_data": [{"min": min_price, "max": max_price}],
            "error_details": None
        }
        AGENT_RESPONSE.write_text(json.dumps(payload))
        log('Final response payload: ' + json.dumps(payload))
        await browser.close()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())

intent: How much refund should I expect from my orders canceled, if any, in Feb 2023, including shipping fee.. Return the value as a number (e.g., 10.99) only, without any additional details.
code:
import asyncio, json, re, shutil
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

WORKSPACE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
FINAL_RUNS = WORKSPACE / 'final_runs'
FINAL_RUNS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
existing = [int(p.name.split('_')[1]) for p in FINAL_RUNS.glob('run_*') if p.is_dir() and p.name.split('_')[1].isdigit()]
run_id = max(existing, default=0) + 1
RUN_DIR = FINAL_RUNS / f'run_{run_id:03d}'
RUN_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
SS_DIR = RUN_DIR / 'screenshots'
SS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
LOG_FILE = RUN_DIR / 'final_script_log.txt'
SELF_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve()
shutil.copy2(SELF_PATH, RUN_DIR / 'final_script.py')

BASE = 'http://ec2-18-223-172-69.us-east-2.compute.amazonaws.com:7770'
USERNAME = 'emma.lopez@gmail.com'
PASSWORD = 'Password.123'
TARGETS = {
    '000000156': {'date_text': 'February 24, 2023', 'expected_total': 231.54},
    '000000158': {'date_text': 'February 11, 2023', 'expected_total': 174.99},
}

step = 0

def log(msg: str):
    with LOG_FILE.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(msg + '\n')
    print(msg)

async def snap(page, action: str):
    global step
    step += 1
    path = SS_DIR / f'final_execution_{step}_{action}.png'
    await page.screenshot(path=str(path))
    log(f'step {step} action: {action}')

async def main():
    LOG_FILE.write_text('')
    refunds = []
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 1280, 'height': 1800})
        page = await context.new_page()

        await page.goto(f'{BASE}/customer/account/login/', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        await page.locator('input[name="login[username]"]').fill(USERNAME)
        await page.locator('input[name="login[password]"]').fill(PASSWORD)
        await page.get_by_role('button', name='Sign In').click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('domcontentloaded')
        await snap(page, 'login_success_account_home')

        await page.get_by_role('link', name='My Orders').click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('domcontentloaded')
        body = await page.locator('body').inner_text()
        assert 'My Orders' in body and '000000156' in body and '000000158' in body
        assert '2/24/23' in body and 'Canceled' in body and '2/11/23' in body
        await snap(page, 'my_orders_feb2023_canceled_orders_visible')

        rows = await page.locator('table tbody tr').all()
        hrefs = {}
        for row in rows:
            txt = (await row.inner_text()).strip()
            for order_no in TARGETS:
                if order_no in txt:
                    hrefs[order_no] = await row.get_by_role('link', name='View Order').get_attribute('href')
                    log(f'found target order row: {txt}')

        for order_no, meta in TARGETS.items():
            href = hrefs[order_no]
            if href.startswith('/'):
                href = BASE + href
            await page.goto(href, wait_until='domcontentloaded')
            detail_text = await page.locator('body').inner_text()
            assert order_no in detail_text
            assert 'Canceled' in detail_text
            assert meta['date_text'] in detail_text
            assert 'Shipping & Handling\t$5.00' in detail_text or 'Shipping & Handling $5.00' in detail_text
            m = re.search(r'Grand Total\s*\$([\d,]+\.\d{2})', detail_text)
            assert m, f'Grand total not found for {order_no}'
            total = float(m.group(1).replace(',', ''))
            assert abs(total - meta['expected_total']) < 0.001
            refunds.append(total)
            log(f'validated order {order_no}: canceled on {meta["date_text"]}, refund including shipping equals grand total {total:.2f}')
            await snap(page, f'order_{order_no}_detail_with_total_and_shipping')

        total_refund = round(sum(refunds), 2)
        response = {
            'task_type': 'RETRIEVE',
            'status': 'SUCCESS',
            'retrieved_data': [total_refund],
            'error_details': None,
        }
        (WORKSPACE / 'agent_response.json').write_text(json.dumps(response), encoding='utf-8')
        log(f'final_response_value: {total_refund:.2f}')
        log(f'agent_response_json: {json.dumps(response)}')
        await snap(page, 'final_state_after_writing_response')
        await browser.close()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())

intent: Get name(s) of reviewer(s) who mention complain of the customer service for the product on the current page
code:
import asyncio
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Dict

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

WORKSPACE = Path(os.environ.get("WORKSPACE_DIR", Path.cwd()))
FINAL_RUNS = WORKSPACE / "final_runs"
FINAL_RUNS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

START_URL = "http://ec2-18-223-172-69.us-east-2.compute.amazonaws.com:7770/epson-workforce-wf-3620-wifi-direct-all-in-one-color-inkjet-printer-copier-scanner-amazon-dash-replenishment-ready.html"

INCLUSION_RULE = (
    "Include only reviews that explicitly complain about customer service, customer support, or service interactions; "
    "exclude reviews that only discuss product quality, ink, setup, warranty, shipping, or generic negativity without a service complaint."
)


def next_run_dir() -> Path:
    existing = []
    for p in FINAL_RUNS.glob("run_*"):
        try:
            existing.append(int(p.name.split("_")[1]))
        except Exception:
            pass
    run_id = max(existing, default=0) + 1
    run_dir = FINAL_RUNS / f"run_{run_id}"
    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    (run_dir / "screenshots").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    return run_dir


class Logger:
    def __init__(self, path: Path):
        self.path = path
        self.path.write_text("")

    def log(self, text: str):
        with self.path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(text.rstrip() + "\n")
        print(text)


async def screenshot(page, path: Path):
    await page.screenshot(path=str(path))


def normalize(s: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()


def parse_reviews(raw_text: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
    text = raw_text.replace("\r", "")
    pattern = re.compile(
        r"(?P<title>.+?)\nRating\s*\n(?P<rating>\d+)%\s*\n(?P<body>.*?)\nReview by (?P<name>.+?)\n\nPosted on (?P<date>.+?)(?=\n\n.+?\nRating\s*\n\d+%\s*\n|\Z)",
        re.S,
    )
    reviews = []
    for m in pattern.finditer(text):
        reviews.append({
            "title": normalize(m.group("title")),
            "rating": normalize(m.group("rating")),
            "body": normalize(m.group("body")),
            "name": normalize(m.group("name")),
            "date": normalize(m.group("date")),
        })
    return reviews


def service_complaint(review: Dict[str, str]) -> bool:
    body = review["body"].lower()
    positive = [
        "customer service",
        "customer support",
        "support phone number",
        "technical support",
        "person on the phone",
        "called customer service",
        "called back",
        "service interactions",
    ]
    complaint_context = [
        "poor excuse",
        "broken english",
        "harder to understand",
        "intelligence insulted",
        "angered me",
        "laughable",
        "wanted to avoid this",
        "told there was no way",
    ]
    if any(p in body for p in positive):
        return True
    if "customer service" in body or "customer support" in body:
        return True
    if ("technical support" in body or "support phone number" in body or "person on the phone" in body) and any(c in body for c in complaint_context):
        return True
    return False


async def main():
    run_dir = next_run_dir()
    screenshots_dir = run_dir / "screenshots"
    run_script = run_dir / "final_script.py"
    shutil.copy2(WORKSPACE / "final_script.py", run_script)
    log = Logger(run_dir / "final_script_log.txt")
    step = 1

    log.log(f"Inclusion rule: {INCLUSION_RULE}")
    log.log(f"Run directory: {run_dir}")

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 1800})
        page = await context.new_page()

        log.log(f"step {step} action: open the specified product page from scratch")
        await page.goto(START_URL, wait_until="networkidle")
        log.log(f"URL: {page.url}")
        log.log(f"TITLE: {await page.title()}")
        await screenshot(page, screenshots_dir / f"final_execution_{step}_product_page.png")
        step += 1

        log.log(f"step {step} action: open the Reviews tab so the product reviews load visibly on the current page")
        await page.locator('#tab-label-reviews, #tab-label-reviews-title').first.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        await screenshot(page, screenshots_dir / f"final_execution_{step}_reviews_loaded_top.png")
        body_text = await page.locator('body').inner_text()
        log.log("BODY_SNIPPET_AFTER_REVIEWS:\n" + body_text[:12000])
        step += 1

        log.log(f"step {step} action: scroll within the loaded reviews and capture evidence of reviews mentioning customer service or support")
        await page.locator("text=Poorly designed, lousy performance").scroll_into_view_if_needed()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
        await screenshot(page, screenshots_dir / f"final_execution_{step}_review_customer_service_bob_in_vegas.png")
        step += 1

        log.log(f"step {step} action: capture a second review mentioning support/customer service interactions")
        await page.locator("text=ExcellentNON-COLOR printer!").scroll_into_view_if_needed()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
        await screenshot(page, screenshots_dir / f"final_execution_{step}_review_customer_support_remyr.png")
        body_text = await page.locator('body').inner_text()
        reviews = parse_reviews(body_text)
        log.log(f"PARSED_REVIEW_COUNT: {len(reviews)}")
        for idx, review in enumerate(reviews):
            log.log(f"REVIEW_{idx+1}: name={review['name']} | title={review['title']} | date={review['date']} | rating={review['rating']}")
            log.log(f"REVIEW_{idx+1}_BODY: {review['body'][:1200]}")

        included = []
        rationales = []
        for review in reviews:
            include = service_complaint(review)
            rationale = (
                f"include={include} | name={review['name']} | "
                f"service_keywords_present={'customer service' in review['body'].lower() or 'customer support' in review['body'].lower() or 'technical support' in review['body'].lower() or 'support phone number' in review['body'].lower() or 'person on the phone' in review['body'].lower()}"
            )
            rationales.append(rationale)
            log.log("REVIEW_DECISION: " + rationale)
            if include:
                included.append(review['name'])

        included = list(dict.fromkeys(included))
        status = "SUCCESS" if included else "NOT_FOUND_ERROR"
        response = {
            "task_type": "RETRIEVE",
            "status": status,
            "retrieved_data": included if included else None,
            "error_details": None,
        }
        (WORKSPACE / "agent_response.json").write_text(json.dumps(response, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        log.log("FINAL_RESPONSE_JSON: " + json.dumps(response))
        await browser.close()

    shutil.copy2(WORKSPACE / "agent_response.json", run_dir / "agent_response.json")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
